slices.title: Implement pixel-perfect UI refresh from approved mockup 20261110013013
slices.jtbd: When implementing design updates for this epic, I want to apply the approved mockup styling and layout structure to the existing frontend components, so that the knowledge base user interface achieves pixel-perfect alignment with the approved design reference.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup design/approved/20261110013013-mockup/mockup.html, When existing frontend templates and stylesheets are updated, Then all visual hierarchy, colors, typography, and responsive layouts match the mockup reference.
Given a viewport of desktop or mobile (375px width), When inspecting the interface, Then horizontal overflow is prevented and contrast ratios satisfy WCAG AAA standards.
